en: Sepia-toned studio photograph showing two women in traditional rural-style dresses and two uniformed soldiers with rifles and pickelhaube spiked helmets. One soldier is holding hands with the central woman while the other soldier, smiling, touches his comrade's helmet. The second woman stands to the left, apparently crying into a cloth near a rustic wooden fence and broom. The painted backdrop suggests a countryside setting. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
